title: Job Ticket 0417
author: Odessa Kiln, Kiln & Co. Salvage
pages: The county called at dawn. Whatever came down on the ridge, they want it cut up and hauled off before the cameras arrive. Cash rate, no paperwork.
I said yes before they finished the sentence. Taking Dell, Rudy, Teo and Marisol. Flatbed, two torches, the big saw. If it's a satellite, the copper alone pays the month.
